description: Display rules for the 39 policy-approved tables. These are presentation definitions, not query permissions or instructions for SQL filters.

defaults.identifiers: Preserve identifiers, codes, names, phone numbers and leading zeros exactly; do not replace numeric IDs with guessed names.
defaults.numbers: Preserve numeric precision and returned units. Do not infer currency, percentages, boolean meanings or rating scales.
defaults.dates: Preserve full dates and timestamps. Do not convert timezone unless the source timezone is established. Business timezone for interpreting questions does not establish the timezone of stored timestamps.
defaults.enums: Apply only the exact table-and-column mapping. Labels improve readability but do not change the stored meaning.
defaults.provenance: Apply mappings only when the output field is verified to originate from that source table and column. Resolve SQL aliases first. Do not apply status mappings to counts, totals, expressions or unrelated 0/1 fields.
defaults.raw_values: Keep raw query results unchanged; display labels are a presentation layer. If the user asks for raw codes, show the original values.
defaults.security: Security policy takes precedence. Never expose a blocked table or column. Display rules do not grant access.

role_type.label: Role type
role_type.note: Keep the numeric role code; named-role mappings have not been approved.

ai_operational_insights.label: AI operational insights
notes: Describe insights and potential savings as recorded estimates, not verified facts.

charge_rates.label: Charge rates
notes: Display recorded rates with their returned precision; do not infer currency or billing units.

executive_bi_metrics.label: Executive BI metrics
notes: Display recorded metrics without inventing formulas, units, currency or rating scales.

guard_availabilities.label: Guard availabilities
notes: Display start_at and end_at as full dated timestamps. Do not describe windows as recurring weekly availability.
NULL boundaries do not establish availability; do not substitute default work hours.
Availability records alone do not establish absence of conflicting shifts.

guard_telemetry.label: Guard telemetry
notes: Include last_ping_at when available; stored location or patrol status is not necessarily current.

pay_rates.label: Pay rates
notes: Display recorded rates with their returned precision; do not infer currency or calculate pay.

payroll_entries.label: Payroll entries
notes: Display recorded amounts and hour categories without inventing pay formulas or currency.

performance_reviews.label: Performance reviews
notes: Display recorded ratings without assuming a scale or inferring performance categories.

shift_assignments.label: Shift assignments
notes: Display the recorded assignment; preserve guard_id and shift_id unless verified joined names are returned.

shifts.label: Shifts
notes: Guard assignment information comes from shift_assignments, not obsolete shifts.guard_id.

timesheets.label: Timesheets
notes: Display recorded hours and amounts; do not calculate unrequested overtime or pay.
